origin: A point whose whole substance is a mechanism, a boundary or a byte — how a repeated name resolves, which of two equivalent fields goes out first, a zero against a newline — is the planner's honest call, not the specification's. The dispose declines one that arrives as a finding: Resolution `Declined` with its reason, the Move left as staged, and nothing rendered for it. The arm needs its own walk because it is the one path where a finding leaves without reaching the user, and an invariant can pin what ran but never that one more render did not. So the case holds the builder's detail beside a call the record determines, which lands from the settled batch, and a genuine choice, which stops even under auto and lands its pick in the discussion that should own it — and the asserter counts the renders.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. They know the discussion cold and treat what it determines as decided, not theirs to re-litigate. The first thing the review puts to them is a one-row screen of calls made on their behalf — how long an order waits for capture confirmation, with the delivery schedule they already agreed named beside it — offering to document the screen, to hand every remaining call over automatically, to pull one out and talk about it, or to expand one. They hand the rest over automatically: they do not want to be stopped again for things the record has already decided. If asked which way round the audit line writes the intent id and the amount, they say it makes no difference to them, nobody outside the team ever reads that line, and they ask why they are being stopped over it. Whether a refund can be for part of an order is different and they treat it differently: nothing decided it, and both ways cost a customer something real. Asked, they reject the recommendation — making somebody send back a whole order to get anything back is how you lose them — and pick refunds down to a single line item instead. The follow-up review cycle runs without asking them and comes back clean, and the session moves to completion on its own; at sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen decided questions.
